90cm Gas Cooktop With 5 Burners, Stainless Steel

EC95GLS

Complete with a high-power WOK burner with dual-valve control allowing you to adjust the flame froma a rapid heat to a low simmer with ease, providing the ultimate level of flexibility for cooking delicious meals for the whole family in no time. Includes dedicated Wok trivet for optimum stability. Available only at selected Harvey Norman, Domayne and Joyce Mayne stores.

  • Five Italian gas burners
  • Dual Valve Wok Burner
  • Flame Safety Device
  • Raised Cast-Iron Trivets

90cm Gas Cooktop With 5 Burners, Black Glass

EC95GLB

Complete with a high-power WOK burner with dual-valve control allowing you to adjust the flame from a rapid heat to a low simmer with ease, providing the ultimate level of flexibility for cooking delicious meals for the whole family in no time.The stylish tempered black glass and heavy duty cast iron trivets make cleaning as easy as lifting and wiping over. Available only at selected Harvey Norman, Domayne and Joyce Mayne stores.
